ios.desc:
MSK — your AI CTO, available 24/7.

Modeled on the experience of Moeid Saleem Khan (15+ years, 300+ projects, 50+ startups), MSK is an AI agent that thinks like a seasoned Chief Technology Officer. Ask it anything about technology, architecture, scaling, AI, hiring, or product strategy and get sharp, opinionated answers grounded in real startup experience.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Chat with your AI CTO about any technical or startup decision
• Get architecture and code reviews — paste your stack, get risks, gaps, and cost insights
• Take the AI Readiness assessment and see where you stand
• Use Voice mode to talk through problems hands-free
• Save the answers that matter and revisit them anytime

FREE TO START
Try it free — no account, no signup. Open the app and start a conversation.

MSK PREMIUM
Upgrade for unlimited messages, voice mode, architecture and code reviews, and a priority intro to Moeid. Monthly or annual, with a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions are billed to your Apple ID and auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel in your App Store settings.

Whether you are a founder without a technical co-founder, an engineer growing into leadership, or a team that needs a second opinion — MSK is the CTO in your pocket.

TERMS & PRIVACY
